story.title: Founding D-SENG in Zhubei
story.text: In 2026, D-SENG Technology was founded in Zhubei, Hsinchu, bringing together our affiliate Gold Stone's deep roots in semiconductor facility systems and materials with our team's hands-on experience in rotating equipment maintenance and AI monitoring. We provide rotating equipment maintenance, AI early-warning monitoring, air compressors, AI vision-guided smart welding, semiconductor materials, and monitoring engineering. Guided by practical innovation, AI-led technology, sustainable development, and integrity, we help customers keep every facility running with greater confidence and longevity.

affiliates.name: Gold Stone
affiliates.text: Founded in 1981, Gold Stone specializes in equipment for semiconductor and optoelectronics fabs and piping materials for gas and chemical systems, offering one-stop supply of tubing, fittings, valves, and pressure instruments. With offices in Taipei, Hsinchu, and Shanghai, it supports fab construction projects and urgent requests with ample inventory at its Zhubei warehouse.

story.title: Origins: Starting with Piping Materials
story.text: Gold Stone Development was founded in 1981 in a field that is easy to overlook yet critical: equipment for semiconductor and optoelectronics fabs, and piping materials for gas and chemical systems. Every gas and chemical flowing through a cleanroom process passes through tubing, fittings, valves, and pressure instruments; if any one of them is unreliable, the production line can come to a halt. Gold Stone started here and has stayed with it for 45 years.

story.title: Depth: Complete Piping Supply from One Source
story.text: Over the years, Gold Stone has steadily built out its product line: stainless steel tubing from 1/16 in. to 600A, a wide range of fittings, VCR and compression fittings, bellows valves and diaphragm valves, regulators, pressure gauges and transducers, and filters, extending to PTFE tubing, PFA fittings and valves, and fire suppression systems. All products come from renowned manufacturers in Japan, the United States, Germany, and Korea, allowing customers to source all the piping materials needed for gas and chemical systems through a single point of contact.

story.title: Support: Backing Fab Construction and Urgent Needs
story.text: Waiting on materials is what facility teams dread most. Gold Stone maintains ample inventory to handle customers' urgent needs and shorten material lead times for fab construction projects; it stocks materials in advance according to project schedules and even serves as customers' spare parts warehouse. From its Taipei and Hsinchu offices and Hsinchu warehouse center to its Shanghai office and Taicang warehouse, Gold Stone has grown alongside the facility teams of the semiconductor and optoelectronics industries with responsive service.

story.title: Extension: A New Warehouse and Partnership with D-SENG
story.text: In January 2026, Gold Stone opened its new warehouse center in Zhubei, preparing for its next stage. In the same year, its affiliated company D-SENG Technology was established in Zhubei. Gold Stone's familiarity with fab facilities and materials complements D-SENG's capabilities in rotating equipment maintenance and AI-based monitoring; through the collaboration between the two companies, new materials such as butyl rubber duct gaskets and nano conductive composite super-crystal are reaching more fabs.

items.title: Rotating Equipment Maintenance
items.summary: Scheduled maintenance, vibration measurement, troubleshooting, and maintenance records for rotating equipment such as facility exhaust fans, blowers, and air compressors, reducing the risk of unplanned downtime.
body: Exhaust fans, blowers, and air compressors run continuously for long periods in the facility systems of semiconductor and high-tech fabs, and the condition of their bearings, couplings, belts, and vibration isolators directly affects equipment availability and site safety. The D-SENG Technology team has hands-on experience in fan design, manufacturing, and repair; we plan scheduled maintenance based on equipment type and operating conditions, carried out on site by professional maintenance technicians.

Equipment can still develop faults after routine maintenance. Common causes include poor bearing housing mounting, wear on shaft surfaces, and misalignment after bearing replacement; faults and damage are often linked to a lack of long-term monitoring and maintenance that is not properly carried out, rather than component life alone. That is why our maintenance goes beyond lubrication and replacement, tying inspection, measurement, and record-keeping into a traceable process.

Each unit has its own maintenance card and inspection records, documenting lubricant changes, grease quantities, vibration measurements, and corrective actions. Maintenance data can be uploaded to the cloud for trend comparison and predictive analysis; combined with our AI early-warning and monitoring service, planned maintenance shutdowns can be scheduled based on actual equipment condition, preventing damage from escalating.

sections.title: Routine Maintenance | Every 40 Days
sections.text: The year is divided into 9 maintenance cycles. Each cycle renews the bearing lubricant and completes basic operating checks.
list: Metered bearing lubrication with an electronic grease gun
Vibration and abnormal noise checks
Fan level check
Vibration isolator check
Visual inspection of couplings or belts

sections.title: Cycle 9 | Full Static and Dynamic Inspection
sections.text: The final cycle of the year is upgraded to a full inspection and maintenance, with worn parts replaced as needed.
list: Complete replacement of lubricant inside bearings
Inspect shaft seals for damage and replace as needed
Check coupling lubricant and top up if low
Inspect inlet and outlet flexible connectors for damage or misalignment
Check vibration isolators for level and corrosion
Check bearing grease nipple ball springs for failure
Inspect belts for cracks or slack
Lubricate bearings, motor, and adjustment screws

items.title: AI Early Warning & Monitoring
items.summary: Wireless vibration and temperature sensors installed on fan bearing housings and motors, with AI interpreting abnormal trends, sending push notifications, and automatically creating work orders for early maintenance.
body: Fan bearing faults, misalignment, impeller imbalance, and belt slack rarely occur suddenly; they gradually emerge in vibration signals. D-SENG Technology's AI early-warning system continuously monitors the vibration and temperature of facility fans, comparing them against international vibration standards and each unit's own operating baseline, and issues warnings before deterioration escalates, so facility staff can schedule maintenance in advance rather than reacting after a shutdown.

The system does more than display values; it focuses on explaining what the data means. When an anomaly is detected, the system analyzes its likely source, suggests corrective actions, and automatically creates a maintenance work order. Our team has hands-on experience in fan design, manufacturing, and repair, and engineers can help interpret data and provide on-site service when needed, closing the loop between monitoring and maintenance.

The system is designed not to interfere with existing facility operations: sensors are mounted magnetically, with no downtime from installation through acceptance; data travels over a dedicated wireless network to an on-site server that is physically isolated from office and process networks; and the system is read-only, issuing no control commands and making no changes to fan or VFD settings.

sections.title: Monitoring Architecture
sections.text: Four layers: sensing, transmission, platform, and alerts. Data is stored on an on-site server by default.
list: Sensing: 3 measurement points per fan, measuring triaxial vibration and temperature
Transmission: dedicated Wi-Fi access points, bypassing the plant network
Platform: on-site server calculates trends and spectra and interprets anomalies
Alerts: automatic push notifications and maintenance work orders
Cloud and remote diagnostics are optional, with outbound-only server connections

sections.title: Sensing & Analysis Methods
sections.text: Measurement points are located on the impeller-side bearing housing, the motor-side bearing housing, and the motor body, covering common problem areas such as bearings, alignment, and the motor.
list: Continuous monitoring of triaxial vibration RMS
Vibration severity assessed per ISO 10816 / ISO 20816
Spectra and time-domain waveforms retained for FFT spectrum analysis
Operating baseline established for each fan
Identifies anomalies such as imbalance, belt slack, and loose bearing housings
IP67-rated sensors suitable for outdoor rooftops

sections.title: Platform Features
sections.text: From a plant-wide overview to the history of a single unit, facility staff can track and act on issues in one platform.

Vibration time series and trend analysis
Alert notifications via email, LINE, or SMS

Installation: sensors, access points, and server

items.title: Air Compressors
items.summary: In partnership with Ingersoll Rand, we provide Class 0 oil-free rotary screw compressors, air treatment equipment, and compressor room planning.
body: Compressed dry air (CDA) is a fundamental utility in semiconductor and electronics fabs, used for pneumatic valves, instrument control, and driving process equipment. Oil, moisture, or particles in the air can affect processes and downstream equipment. D-SENG Technology partners with Ingersoll Rand to provide oil-free rotary screw compressors along with air treatment equipment such as dryers and filters, helping customers obtain stable, clean compressed air.

With a history of more than 165 years, Ingersoll Rand offers oil-free rotary screw compressors that are TÜV-certified to ISO 8573-1 Class 0 oil-free air. The product line covers oil-free rotary screw models from 37 kW to 355 kW, available in fixed-speed and variable speed drive (VSD), air-cooled and water-cooled configurations, to suit varying air demand and site conditions.

Beyond the equipment itself, we take a system-level approach to help customers evaluate air demand, pressure settings, and compressor combinations, plan compressor room layout, drying, filtration, and piping, and combine genuine parts with regular maintenance to reduce energy consumption and downtime risk across the compressed air system's life cycle.

items.title: Smart Seam-Tracking Welding
items.summary: In partnership with BOSCHDA, we use line laser sensors and weld pool cameras to guide welding, automatically generating weld paths and correcting seam deviations in real time.
body: D-SENG Technology partners with BOSCHDA, a specialist in visual weld seam tracking, to offer vision-guided automated welding solutions. BOSCHDA focuses on welding vision guidance, motion control, process control, and production line automation. Its seam tracking systems provide automatic vision guidance for straight seams, circumferential seams, and 3D curved seams, and support TIG, laser, plasma, gas-shielded, and submerged arc welding, with applications in industrial pipe manufacturing, steel structures, pressure vessels, ventilation ducts, and shipbuilding.

The system scans the seam profile with a line laser sensor and observes the weld pool in real time with a weld pool camera; the control system then calculates the offset and drives an electric slide, dedicated welding machine, or robot to correct the torch position, tracking both lateral and vertical directions simultaneously. Depending on the model, lateral detection accuracy reaches ±0.02 mm, handling workpiece fit-up errors, thermal distortion, and interference from arc light and spatter in gas-shielded welding.

For pipe fitting manufacturing, the fully automated elbow and tee welding station handles workpieces 100–500 mm in diameter. After the workpiece is positioned in a pneumatic fixture, a single button starts the process: the system first generates the weld path and torch orientation through vision scanning, then the weld pool camera corrects the position in real time during welding, with no manual teaching required. D-SENG Technology helps customers evaluate implementation options and equipment configurations based on workpiece specifications, welding power sources, and on-site workflow.

sections.title: System Components
sections.text: The seam tracking system consists of sensors, a control system, and actuators, with different models available to meet on-site integration requirements.
list: Weld pool camera: clear weld pool detail with wide dynamic range imaging
Line laser sensor: scans seam profile, Ethernet communication
3D camera: captures workpiece point clouds for locating large workpieces
Control system: identifies the seam and calculates real-time offset
Actuators: electric slides, dedicated welding machines, or robots
Supports RS485, Ethernet, or pulse/direction control

sections.title: Applicable Seams & Processes

Joint types: butt, fillet, lap, and groove joints
Processes: TIG, laser, and plasma welding
Processes: gas-shielded, submerged arc, and laser-MIG hybrid welding
Pipe-to-pipe butt joints can use TIG root passes with MIG fill and cap passes

items.title: Semiconductor Materials & Engineering
items.summary: Fully encapsulated butyl rubber duct gaskets, nano conductive composite super-crystal, and high-purity tubing and fittings, with integrated service from material selection to on-site installation.
body: Where facility exhaust ducts connect to tanks, components are exposed to acidic and alkaline gases and liquids over long periods. Once a flange joint leaks, corrosive crystallization forms, and drips can even endanger equipment and personnel below, or become a source of cleanroom contamination. D-SENG Technology supplies fully encapsulated butyl rubber (IIR) gaskets that improve the airtightness and corrosion resistance of duct flanges through both material properties and installation method.

For power systems, we supply nano conductive composite super-crystal (conductive gel), applied to metal contact interfaces such as switchboards, busbars, and terminals to block moisture and contaminants and slow oxidation and corrosion of contacts. We also supply the stainless steel, plastic tubing, and rubber materials commonly used in semiconductor fabs, and undertake installation of gas and liquid delivery piping and ductwork.

sections.title: Fully Encapsulated Butyl Rubber Duct Gaskets
sections.text: Conventional EPDM gaskets are prone to chemical attack and damage in high-concentration acid gas environments; during installation, gaskets also often sag off-center under gravity or fail to conform to the R-corner of the duct flange fold, causing leaks. Encapsulated IIR gaskets address these issues through both material and structural design.
list: Encapsulated design stays centered on the flange without sagging
Thickened barrier layers on inner and outer rings, with dual sealing rings on both sides
Reinforced, thickened sealing layer at the duct flange R-corner
Can be pre-assembled at ground level, reducing work at height
Works with standard 6-bolt ducts; no special reinforced ducts required
Suitable for duct, PCW, chilled water, and industrial piping flanges

sections.title: Material Properties & Test Verification
sections.text: Butyl rubber is based on isobutylene, with a highly saturated main chain and low gas and water vapor permeability. The material is inspected to ASTM D2000 BA708, with no inferior fillers added.
list: Low permeability, with good airtightness and elasticity
Resistant to acids, alkalis, ozone, and weathering, with good aging resistance
Good electrical insulation, reducing galvanic corrosion
Passed 30-day acid and alkali immersion testing at a third-party laboratory
No leakage with duct filled with water, pressurized to 5 kg/cm², and held for 5 days
Installed on site in a semiconductor fab, with no leakage over more than 6 months of tracking

sections.title: Nano Conductive Composite Super-Crystal
sections.text: Power distribution systems contain a large number of metal contacts. Microscopic irregularities on contact surfaces allow moisture and contaminants to penetrate, and heat generated under current accelerates oxidation and corrosion and raises contact resistance. This product is a liquid conductive gel; according to manufacturer data, it features low surface energy, chemical inertness, and diamagnetic properties, and is used to protect contact interfaces.
list: Applied to metal joint surfaces such as busbars, terminals, and switches
Suppresses capillary penetration, blocking moisture and contaminants
Applied with a brush; no heating or curing required
Power must be disconnected before application, and work performed by qualified electrical personnel
Manufacturer data: field applications at currents of 1–28,000 A

items.title: Monitoring Engineering
items.summary: Cleanroom environmental monitoring, airborne molecular contamination (AMC) monitoring, and monitoring system engineering to help customers continuously track site environmental conditions.
body: Semiconductor and optoelectronics processes are highly sensitive to the cleanliness of their environment. Beyond airborne particles, airborne molecular contamination (AMC) can also affect process stability and product yield. D-SENG Technology provides cleanroom environmental monitoring, AMC monitoring, and related monitoring engineering, helping customers continuously track site environmental conditions and identify potential contamination sources early.

For a monitoring system to be effective, the key is whether point placement, alarm conditions, and follow-up procedures fit the site. D-SENG Technology's scope of services covers process equipment monitoring and measurement systems as well as piping installation for gas and liquid delivery systems. We help plan monitoring items and points based on site requirements and handle system installation and construction.

Our affiliated company Gold Stone has long supplied piping materials for gas and chemical systems to semiconductor and optoelectronics fabs. When planning monitoring projects, D-SENG Technology can take monitoring equipment together with the related piping, fittings, and valves into account, so that monitoring data feeds reliably into facility management as a basis for environmental improvement and incident handling.

sections.text: The monitoring system consists of sensing, signal transmission, and monitoring stations, with the architecture planned around the monitoring items and interfaces to existing facility systems.

scenes.title: AI Monitoring System
scenes.text: Vibration sensors watch the fan around the clock, and AI warns before a fault grows, turning emergency repairs into planned maintenance.

scenes.title: Oil-Free Rotary Screw Air Compressor
scenes.text: Two-stage compression with intercooling and oil-free operation delivers clean compressed air for semiconductor and other high-purity processes.

scenes.title: Smart Seam-Tracking Welding
scenes.text: A vision camera tracks the seam in real time while the robot welds pipe branch joints and duct girth seams with consistent quality.

scenes.title: Wrap-Around Butyl Rubber Duct Gasket
scenes.text: The outer lip wraps the flange; when tightened, the rubber fills the unevenness of the flange faces so the duct joint stays airtight.

scenes.title: Nano Super-Crystal Coating
scenes.text: Applied to busbar joints and terminals in switchboards, nano crystals fill the microscopic voids in metal surfaces, reducing contact resistance and heat.
